what: The lead's last harness fix, after harness_last_recheck.json (verdict ready_with_fixes): its fixes_needed items 1 and 2, done in vhi_guard.py and proofs.py; the spec is unchanged
item_1_identity_pinned: resolve_cut_declared now takes os.stat and os.lstat of DECLARED_PATH BEFORE the path rule runs and passes them to declaration_check; _protocol_identity accepts the descriptor only if its (st_dev, st_ino) equals that pinned identity as well as the current one. A first version pinned AFTER the path rule; the two new race rows of proof i caught it (accepted instead of refused); the pin was moved before the path rule and both rows are now refused.
